item.description: Last night in Atlanta, Mastodon played a tour warmup as “Big Hairy Elephant,” and they brought out John Baizley for the second half of the set. With the Baroness frontman they did several live rarities including a song from ‘Blood Mountain,’ which coincidentally was released 20 years ago today.

item.title: Charli XCX kicked off Music, Fashion, Film Fall in Philly la…
item.author: Stereogum (@stereogum.com)
item.description: Charli XCX kicked off Music, Fashion, Film Fall in Philly last night. She gave “Persona” its live debut, sang “Stay Away” for the first time since 2022, and brought out opener underscores for “Do It.” On IG, Charli also responded to fans who are disappointed next year’s EU/UK leg will be so short.
